source.dataset: ERCOT Native Load 2025, hourly by weather zone

method.four_cp: Each June-September day whose ERCOT system peak came within 2% of that month's peak is an alert day; pause the day's peak hour and the hour on each side.
method.houston: Pause any hour the COAST weather zone (Houston) was within 2% of its annual peak.
method.caveat: Hourly data: ERCOT's official 4CP intervals are 15 minutes. Alert days are picked after the fact; in practice operators act on day-ahead 4CP alerts, so real pause hours are similar but not identical.

tcrf.basis: CenterPoint Transmission Cost Recovery Factor, Primary Service (IDR), $ per 4CP kVA per month, as listed on CenterPoint's Houston Electric rates page (no date shown). Assumes power factor 1.
tcrf.label: Estimated
